Whoever swears falsely by another religion is as he said; whoever kills himself by iron, throttling or stabbing repeats it in Hell, and Paradise was forbidden to one who did.
A fierce fighter the Prophet places among the people of the Fire kills himself when wounded; one may seem to do Paradise's deeds yet belong to the Fire.
Whoever kills himself by throwing himself from a mountain, by poison or with an iron weapon will go on doing so in the Fire forever.
